title: Gintama'
synopsis:
After a one-year hiatus, Shinpachi Shimura returns to Edo, only to stumble upon a shocking surprise: Gintoki and Kagura, his fellow Yorozuya members, have become completely different characters! Fleeing from the Yorozuya headquarters in confusion, Shinpachi finds that all the denizens of Edo have undergone impossibly extreme changes, in both appearance and personality. Most unbelievably, his sister Otae has married the Shinsengumi chief and shameless stalker Isao Kondou and is pregnant with their first child.

Bewildered, Shinpachi agrees to join the Shinsengumi at Otae and Kondou's request and finds even more startling transformations afoot both in and out of the ranks of the the organization. However, discovering that Vice Chief Toushirou Hijikata has remained unchanged, Shinpachi and his unlikely Shinsengumi ally set out to return the city of Edo to how they remember it.

With even more dirty jokes, tongue-in-cheek parodies, and shameless references, Gintama' follows the Yorozuya team through more of their misadventures in the vibrant, alien-filled world of Edo.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

episodes_data.title: Everyone Looks a Little Grown Up After Spring Break
episodes_data.description: Shinpachi Shimura returns to the Yorozuya and discovers his friends drastically changed during the break. Feeling left behind, he returns home and discovers his sister, Tae Shimura, engaged to Isao Kondo. Tae and Kando enlists Shinpachi into the Shinsengumi and reveals that Tae is pregnant. Shinpachi runs to the ocean and laments the sudden changes of those around him. There, he learns about Kyubei Yagyu`s sex change to modify her life. They are interrupted by Kotaro Katsura who also changed his gender due to his and Kyubei`s characters` similarities.

episodes_data.title: Everyone Looks Pretty Grown Up After Summer Break
episodes_data.description: As Katsura and Kyubei fight for the title of the best transgendered, Shinpachi leaves to find that the Shinsengumi members also suffered a sudden change in their selves; Sogo Okita is the leader from the group and orders him and Toshiro Hijikata, Sagaru Yamazaki to attack the Yorozuya. As the three leave, Hijikata knocks out Yamazaki, as he was faking his change. He and Shinpachi learn that an invasion of parasite aliens is responsible for change to their friends and proceed to destroy them. However, they find problems in the outcome, and both Hijikata and and Shinpachi are knocked out in the process, with Gintoki being actually only person without a parasite.

episodes_data.title: Use a Calligraphy Pen for New Year Cards / The Heart Comes Before Chocolate
episodes_data.description: As Gintoki complains of writing News Years cards, Yorozuya learn of what his friends have done over the holidays. He also receives cards saying his friends have gotten married, while they have lied and just Photoshopped the photos. The episode ends with Kondo, Sachan and Hasegawa telling their story of how they wrote a News Years card. The second part starts with the same opening, but Gin complains of the lack of chocolate. Kagura has a chocolate for Gintoki and Shinpachi, but is too embarrassed to give to them. She enlists the help of Otae, Sachan and Tsukuyo to help, but they are each too embarrassed to help her and make her give their chocolates to Gintoki. She indifferently give Gintoki and Shipachi the chocolate saying they were on the door step, as the happily run for the chocolate, they find all the chocolates were said to be from Kagura.

episodes_data.title: Meals Should Be Balanced / We Are All Warriors in the Battle Against Fate
episodes_data.description: Yamazaki has a mental breakdown cause of Anpans and Kondo finally gets a date (Or does he!)

episodes_data.title: It's Too Confusing When Talking About the Poster Girl for a Poster Store, So Call Her a Sandwich Board
episodes_data.description: Catherine appears to have a boyfriend and has drastically improved her appearance. Her boyfriend is a regular at Snack Otose, an entrepreneur by the name of Suejiro. Catherine decides to leave the Kabuki district to start a new bar with him.

episodes_data.title: Glasses Are Part of the Soul
episodes_data.description: The Odd Jobs` TV breaks out with Sachan inside. Gintoki tells Sadaharu to throw her away with the TV, but Sachan`s precious glasses are broken in the process. Gintoki reluctantly buys Sa-chan a new pair of glasses, but they are bottle bottom glasses that are clearly the wrong prescription. Sa-chan is overjoyed that Gintoki has given her a present, but the new glasses are responsible for a chain of failures on her assassination job. Her superiors now question her commitment.

episodes_data.title: Glasses Prevent You From Seeing Certain Things
episodes_data.description: Gintoki and crew continue to defend Sarutobi against the Lethal Punishers. But against such assassins as the Pillow Masa, T-shirt Tatsu, and the Chuubert Chu Brothers, will they win?

episodes_data.title: Nothing Lasts Forever, Including Parents, Money, Youth, Your Room, Dress Shirts, Me, You, and the Gintama Anime
episodes_data.description: Due to a lack of budget, the Yorozuya try to use old footage to make a filler episodes. While Hasegawa first plays a theme song, the characters then watch a fake trailer a supposed second film based on the series. The episode ends with a chapter of "Teach us Ginpachi-sensei", a story in which Gintoki is the teacher from high school class composed of anime`s characters.

episodes_data.title: A Lawless Town Tends to Attract a Bunch of Whoohooey Folk
episodes_data.description: Pirako Chin is looking for the strongest man in the Kabuki District. Now Gintoki has an underling who wants to turn Kabuki District into a garden of bright red flowers.

episodes_data.title: Ghosts Aren't the Only Ones Who Run Wild Around Graveyards
episodes_data.description: Pirako`s real plan is to help Jirocho, her father, take over the town.

episodes_data.title: Chains of a Warrior
episodes_data.description:
Pirako is pleased to hear that Otose, the reason for Jirocho`s attachment to the Kabuki district, has been eliminated.  With Otose gone, the balance of power among the Four Devas has crumbled and a war is in the works in the Kabuki district.
Meanwhile, the Odd Jobs crew is watching over Otose when Saigo appears and informs them that the bar will be destroyed by the Four Devas.  He urges them to leave this town, now that they`ve lost their home...Finally, the day comes for them to leave Snack Otose.

episodes_data.title: Iron Town
episodes_data.description: Tama, Tatsumi, Tetsuko, Kozen, Madao, Kyoshiro. Everybody is out in full force to fight for the Kabuki District. Male escorts vs. trannies, Cabaret girls vs. Yakuza, robots blowing things up. It’s an all-out war!

episodes_data.title: 'Tis An Honor!
episodes_data.description: Jirocho and Gin battle Kada`s elite Harusame forces while the rest of the denizens of Kabuki-cho take on her main forces in the streets. Kada is utterly stunned when her elite forces are beat by just these two humans, and flees the scene. Gin then helps Jirocho resolve his issues regarding Tatsugoro; Otose and Jirocho reconcile at the hospital. Outside the hospital, Kada desperately launches one last feeble attempt at conquering Kabuki-cho, but is stopped in her tracks by Pirako and the Yorozuya - Kada settles for swearing that the Harusame will be back, and flees yet again. At the very end, Jirocho denounces all other names he has ever been called except for Father of Pirako, and goes with his daughter back to the country.

episodes_data.title: Odds or Evens
episodes_data.description: Kagura`s older brother, Kamui, visits Kada`s cell where she is being kept after having been captured by the Kiheitai and loses at a game of odds or evens. He is approached by one of the 12 captains who tells him he has the 12 captains support if he chooses to overthrow Admiral Abo. Kamui orders his second to kill the members of the Kiheitai, isolating Takasugi so Kamui can duel him. As the Kiheitai`s ship is about to be attacked the Admiral double crosses Kamui and imprisons him out of fear. Takasugi visits Kada`s cell and loses at a game of odds or evens. After a brief conversation Takasugi rescues Kamui at his execution, overthrowing Admiral Abo. Kamui becomes Admiral and the episode ends with Takasugi visiting Kada`s cell one last time to lose at a game of odds or evens.

episodes_data.title: I Can't Remember a Damn Thing About the Factory Tour
episodes_data.description: Kagura invites a bunch of kids to the Yorozuya. They, along with other characters get shunned by them and invites them into a "factory tour".

episodes_data.title: What Happens Twice Can Happen Thrice
episodes_data.description: Gintoki and Hasegawa have to help the shogun when he is at the pool.

episodes_data.title: The Pincers of a Crab Can Snip Through a Friendship
episodes_data.description: Otose sent a box of crab to the Yoruzuya. Before they can divide the crab`s legs to themselves, suddenly, there came a blackout after the electricity came back one leg is missing and Gintoki ate it. Another blackout came and another leg was missing and Kagura ate it, saying she was attacked by a gorilla. Shinpachi then put up a candle. Then Gintoki and Kagura ate all of the legs. When Shinpachi claims the crab`s whole body they found themselves fighting for a crab congee and ended up eating crab-flavored cheap food.

episodes_data.title: People Forget to Return Stuff All the Time Without Even Realizing It
episodes_data.description: Kagura helps a iwamatsu, the last part have the yoruzuya and shinsengumi in the bathhouse just as neighbor Hedero arrives with family members visiting Edo.

episodes_data.title: The Bathhouse, Where You're Naked in Body and Soul
episodes_data.description: Gin, Kondo, Hijkata, Okita, and Shin are stuck in the public bath with the demons. Every lie they tell digs their grave deeper. Can they really get away with kicking heads in, ripping off horns, and setting demons on fire with lotion?

episodes_data.title: Jugem
episodes_data.description: The monkey, aka "Jugem Jugem... (abbreviated) Runny Diarrhea," has grown close to Kyubei. However, their time together did not last. The Shogun family ordered that the Yagyu return Runny Diarrhea. The monkey escapes from the Shogun family to see Kyubei again. Kyubei and the other Yagyu members are forced to continue a desperate and fruitless search for Runny Diarrhea.

episodes_data.title: The Name Reveals the Person
episodes_data.description: The monkey, aka "Jugem Jugem... (abbreviated) Runny Diarrhea," has grown close to Kyubei.  However, their time together did not last.  The Shogun family ordered that the Yagyu return Runny Diarrhea.  The monkey escapes from the Shogun family to see Kyubei again.  Kyubei and the other Yagyu members are forced to continue a desperate and fruitless search for Runny Diarrhea...

episodes_data.title: The Man's Household Situation is Hard, His Heart is Soft
episodes_data.description: Katsura infiltrates Matsudaira`s household and ends up pondering family values.

episodes_data.title: Blue and Red Ecstasy
episodes_data.description: The Yorozuya run into a mysterious Blu-ray DVD with a depressed female ghost in it. The ghost moves into their TV, making all the programs gloomy as well. Gintoki then attempts to find use for the ghost as a navigator.

episodes_data.title: So in the Second Season of Prison Break, They're Already Broken Out of Prison, But the Name Works Once You Realize That Society is a Prison
episodes_data.description: Gintoki gets thrown in prison after being framed, and while he`s made an enemy of the warden, he`s managed to become the boss of the prisoners. With his underling Shachi in tow, Gintoki skips his menial labor duties to search the warden`s room for anything incriminating. Understanding that the punishment will be fatal if they are caught, Gintoki disguises himself by putting on pajamas...

episodes_data.title: Everybody Loves Pajamas
episodes_data.description: Gintoki continues creating havoc in the prison.

episodes_data.title: Speaking of Crossovers, Don't Forget About Alien vs. Predator
episodes_data.description: This episode is a sidestory!  Gintama has been involved in many (one-sided) crossovers.  This time, they`re working with the Jump comedy manga Sket Dance!  An episodic anime that airs on Thursdays at 6 PM about a group of three odd jobbers with plenty of laughs and tears...  Sounds very similar to Gintama.  As Gintoki warns that the Sket Dan is coming after Gintama, the Sket Dan members appear and offer a challenge!

episodes_data.title: Love is Neither Plus Nor Minus
episodes_data.description: Shinpachi introduces his new girlfriend to Otae...but she turns out to be Momo-san, a character from the popular Love Choris game.  There are more and more boys in Edo who can no longer distinguish game from reality like Shinpachi.  Otae asks Gintoki to bring Shinpachi back to the real world.  The only way is by entering the world of Love Choris and talking some sense into him.  Gintoki ends up choosing a very unique heroine to be his girlfriend...

episodes_data.title: Making It Through Love
episodes_data.description: Gintoki is participating in the My Wife World Tournament so he can cure Shinpachi of his addiction to the romance simulation game Love Choris.  The tournament involves in-game dates with the heroines.  In the Momo group, Shinpachi uses a passive approach to dominate the other players!

episodes_data.title: It Would Take Too Much Effort to Make This Title Sound Like a Text Message Subject
episodes_data.description: Kagura begs Gintoki for a cell phone, but the tight Odd Jobs budget won`t allow for one.  That`s when they discover three cell phones in Sadaharu`s poop!  They immediately have the technical whiz Gengai fix the phones and each member gets one.  Kagura is ecstatic to have a cell phone, but Gintoki and Shinpachi are annoyed by her incessant texting...

episodes_data.title: When You Go to a Funeral For the First Time, You're Surprised by How Happy the People Are
episodes_data.description: Odd Jobs attends the funeral for the owner of the restaurant they frequented.  A few Shinsengumi members are also present.  Gintoki and Hijikata, known for their bizarre sense of taste, lament the loss of one of Edo`s treasures...  As the funeral proceeds, the dead owner suddenly makes a move!!  Only Gintoki and Hijikata can see him...  But when they try to escape from the owner...

episodes_data.title: The People You Tend to Forget Tend to Show Up After You Forget Them
episodes_data.description: Elizabeth vanishes, leaving behind a sign that says "Don`t look."  Katsura asks Odd Jobs to help look for him, but then he remembers that it`s been a year since he last saw Elizabeth.  He never even realized that Elizabeth had left home!  They decide to go to Katsura`s home to search for clues.

episodes_data.title: Space Ururun Homestay
episodes_data.description: Katsura and the Odd Jobs members learn the truth about Elizabeth`s disappearance from his former lover, Fumiko.  He was actually a spy from the legendary mercenary tribe, the Renho.  Fumiko asks them to protect Earth and Elizabeth from the Renho.  Meanwhile, a strange rain is turning the faces of the people of Edo with Elizabeth faces who can only communicate with signs!  The invasion of the Renho army has begun.

episodes_data.title: Piggy Banks and Trash Cans
episodes_data.description: Odd Jobs, Katsura, and Sakamoto disguise themselves as Renho to join Fumiko in infiltrating the enemy base.  Dark Vader, feared by all as the evil lord, plans to use the Renho`s anti-samurai Gunsams to attack while the people of Earth are distracted by the rain.  Gintoki and the others must stop the invasion of Earth before it`s too late, but instead they appear to be bonding with the Renho.  That is when Elizabeth, General Eren, appears!

episodes_data.title: Empty Planet
episodes_data.description: Gintoki and Sakamoto reveal themselves and attack the Double Dragon generals.  Meanwhile, Elizabeth has launched in the Gunsam to battle Dark Vader in a duel to the death.  Elizabeth is helpless against Dark Vader.  That is when Katsura arrives to protect his friend`s back!

episodes_data.title: Don't Say Goodbye Lionel Will You Survive
episodes_data.description: Gintoki and co have launched in the Galactic Merchant Fleet Robot Kaien to take out Dark Vader.  Having made peace with the Renho, they now fight for their pride as Earthlings and samurai against Dark Vader, who has become one with the Renho home planet.  Will they be able to restore peace to the universe?

episodes_data.title: Please Take Me Skiing
episodes_data.description: Matsudaira forces the Shinsengumi to take a vacation to the ski slopes.  He tells them to enjoy their time off, but in reality, they`ve been sent to guard the Shogun on his first snowboard trip.  The Shinsengumi members are doing their best to protect the Shogun since their lives are on the line, but then they run into some familiar faces...

episodes_data.title: A Vacation in Disorientation
episodes_data.description: The Shinsengumi is tricked into escorting the Shogun on his first snowboarding trip.  Then they run into the Odd Jobs members.  Yada yada, everybody`s stranded in the middle of the mountains, plus the Shogun is missing.  Hijikata orders a search for the Shogun while securing warm shelter.

episodes_data.title: You know those year-end parties where you keep drinking until you've forgotten everything that happened the past year? There are a few things you're not supposed to forget
episodes_data.description: It`s a year-end party at Odd Jobs!  The Gintama anime has been through a lot, but Gintoki tells Kagura and Shinpachi to keep it cool.  And then the usual members join in for some real partying... The next morning, Gintoki wakes up to discover that he`s made some very bad mistakes. Will Gin-san be able to survive the worst blunder in five years of Gintama!?

episodes_data.title: People can Only Live by Forgetting the Bad
episodes_data.description: After getting drunk at the year-end party, Gintoki managed to become a six-timer in one night. In order to prevent the show from being pulled off the air, Gintoki is forced into engaging in a relationship with all of them.  And now he has to go on dates with all of them at the same time...!

episodes_data.title: We Are All Hosts, in Capital Letters
episodes_data.description: The number one host in the Kabuki district, Kyoshiro, summons the Odd Jobs members to his club, Takamagahara, and tells them that he intends to quit because of a lady named Madame Yagami who controls the night world.  It seems that she declared she would be making a second visit to Takamagahara, which is essentially a death sentence.  The hosts at Kyoshiro`s have quit out of fear, so Gintoki and co must find hosts to handle the Madame...

episodes_data.title: Girls Like Vegeta, Guys Like Piccolo
episodes_data.description: The Madame`s arrival is imminent.  Kyoshiro, Gintoki, and friends attempt to scout some help, but they end up with a bunch of oddballs.  And it turns out that Otae has invited guests from all over town who go wild and leave the bar and Kyoshiro broken!  There`s no time to worry about taking care of customers.  But at the worst possible time, Madame Yagami arrives!

episodes_data.title: Draw Your Life on the Canvas We Call Manga
episodes_data.description: Jellybeans Vanguard Honda is on his fifth year as a Jump editor.  However, he`s been assigned to the manga Gintaman, which has driven multiple editors insane.  In order to save himself, Honda must find a new talented artist so he can be reassigned.  One day, he is visited by an aspiring manga artist by the name of N3016.  Is this artist as juvenile as his name suggests?

episodes_data.title: Check It Out!!
episodes_data.description: The Sasaki family is as elite as it gets, and one of its members, Tetsunosuke, has joined the Shinsengumi.  He would have joined the Mimawarigumi, a police force with pedigree, but he is considered a troublemaker, which is why he was sent to the Shinsengumi.  Kondo assigns Tetsu to Hijikata as an assistant, so Hijikata is forced to endure the new recruit...

episodes_data.title: Thorny and Rosy
episodes_data.description: Tetsunosuke has completely changed as he sincerely tries to perform his new job.  Isaburo despises Tetsunosuke and tells Hijikata that he should dispose of him, but Hijikata, who came from a similar background, sympathizes with Tetsunosuke and looks after him.  Meanwhile, Gintoki, who was arrested by the Mimawarigumi, has been assigned a mission by Isaburo...

episodes_data.title: Festival of Thornys
episodes_data.description: Tetsunosuke has been ordered to deliver a letter for Hijikata.  However, he`s captured by the radical Joi Check It Out gang in the process.  Tetsunosuke had concealed his identity to join the gang, but now they know that he has connections to the police.  He`s taken hostage as leverage over the Shinsengumi and Mimawarigumi.  However, the Mimawarigumi shows no concern for the hostage and plots to place the blame squarely on the Shinsengumi.  Hijikata and the other members are enraged after learning Isaburo`s plans.  The Shinsengumi and Mimawarigumi are now in an all-out fight.

episodes_data.title: Letter from Thorny
episodes_data.description: The Shinsengumi attempt to save Tetsunosuke from the Check It Out gang, but the Mimawarigumi stands in the way.  Neither side is willing to back down, but Gintoki, who had infiltrated the gang as a Mimawarigumi spy, manages to save Tetsunosuke! Kondo orders the Shinsengumi to begin fighting back!

episodes_data.title: Madaodog Madaonaire
episodes_data.description: The middle-aged dumb-ass oldie, or Madao, Taizo Hasegawa finds himself on a game show with a chance to win ten million yen. Will he be able to endure the pressure and become a Madaonaire!?  And what is Madao`s motivation for participating in the game show...?

episodes_data.title: Presents Are Meant to Be Given Early
episodes_data.description: A character from 2 years ago is back with a request for Gin.  This favor will take the Odd-Job Trio right in the middle of Satan Festival in this very special Christmas episode.

episodes_data.title: New Year's Envelopes Are Perfect for Dirty Jokes
episodes_data.description: Gin is trying to hand out New Year Envelopes but the lack of children characters make it hard.  To make matters worse, everyone seems to have their mind wrapped around long cylindrical objects and small spherical objects.

episodes_data.title: When Sleeping Under a Kotatsu, Make Sure You Don't Burn Your Balls
episodes_data.description: Nobody cares anymore, the animators, producers, not even Hideaki Sorachi.  Aww, it’s such a drag even the characters are airing their grievances.  Where do we go from here?

episodes_data.title: We're Sorry
episodes_data.description: Its last episode and we are going out with a bang.  A Gintama clip show!

specials_data.title: Cherry Blossom Festival (2011)
specials_data.description: Like previous Gintama live event in 2010, special animated segments were shown. And also, live dubbing performance by the series` seiyuu to clips from Gintama (2006) and Gintama` (2011), live band performances and more.
